_schema._file: Species data in the pokemon.json schema ({"species": {id: species}}, plus energy_types, type_energy, energy_names and type_chart), a drop-in dataset for the engine (Kanto151Data.install()). The Kanto 151, keyed by id, in Pokédex order. Built by tools/native/kanto151/gen.py. Engine keys first, then the design's extra keys.
_schema.name: the shown name
_schema.types: its Pokemon types; its pools are their energy kinds (type_energy) plus Colorless
_schema.energy: its pools as the engine makes them: typed (in type order) then Colorless
_schema.rarity: common | uncommon | rare | very_rare | legendary: the card rarity blended with how rare it is in the world
_schema.weakness: energy kinds it is weak to (its SV151 card; battle_config matchups.weakness_mult); [] for the Dragon line (their cards have none)
_schema.resistance: energy kinds it resists (battle_config matchups.resistance_mult / resistance_sub)
_schema.base: [hp, atk, def, spa, spd, spe] main-series base stats
_schema.wild_levels: [lo, hi]: a placeholder band by stage and rarity
_schema.learnset: [{level, move, src: game | tcg | anime | new | design, inherited, anime, tcg}] in level order (never forgotten)
_schema.tm: move ids it can be taught (TM, HM or tutor, in any game)
_schema.tutor: extra: the tm moves that come from a tutor
_schema.egg: extra: egg moves (a breeding hook; teach() with force)
_schema.focus_profile: extra: its focus params in battle_config focus terms {gain, step, chip_cap, start, disrupt_resist}: the config's defaults, by_type and species entries, the design's overrides, then the rarity bonus; install() writes them into focus.species
_schema.tcg: extra: the card it follows: card, type (its primary energy), rarity, set, weakness, resistance (the card's -20 / -30), attacks, abilities
_schema.evolution: extra: {line, stage, from, into, method: level | stone | trade | friendship, level, item}
_schema.openers: extra: every move it can use costing 1 chip
_schema.off_pool: extra: moves whose typed cost needs a pool it lacks (balance off_pool: paid in Colorless at a power cut, once the engine supports it)
_schema._notes: extra: TCG typing notes, eras, uncertainty

_notes: TCG data: the Pokémon TCG API's Scarlet & Violet 151 set (sv3pt5, 2023), which prints every one of the 151 with current types, weakness, resistance and rarity. Older eras differ; see each species' _notes.

Game data: PokeAPI, every move each species can learn in any main-series game (level-up, TM/HM, tutor, egg). Learn levels come from the Kanto-era games first (Yellow, Red/Blue, FireRed/LeafGreen, Let's Go), then the newest game.

The TCG weakness chain is followed: Water beats Fire, Lightning beats Water, Fire beats Grass, Grass beats Fighting, Fighting beats Lightning, Darkness and Colorless, Darkness beats Psychic, Metal beats the Psychic-type fairies.
